literal: In the middle of the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed.

literal: All officials prepared the imperial standards and carriage to welcome him, entering to receive the imperial succession.
idiomatic: The officials prepared the imperial escort to welcome him and install him in the imperial line.

literal: When the itinerant headquarters reached Jiangling, they presented the seal and ribbon.
idiomatic: When the mobile imperial secretariat reached Jiangling, the seal and ribbon of investiture were presented.

literal: Attendant-in-Ordinary Pei, Regular Attendant Cao, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Protects the Army and Duke of Jiancheng Liang, Left Guards General Jingren, Attendant-of-the-Interior and General Who Punishes Brigands and Marquis of Longxiang Long, Colonel of Rapid Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Gang, Attendant and Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Suizhi, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi, Colonel of the Feathered Forest and Marquis Who Opens the State of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Senior Concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section, and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Gentleman of the Ministry of Rites Xu Changlin, Gentleman of the Ministry of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Gentleman of the Ministry of Punishments Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "We have heard that adversity and prosperity transform each other; when the number is exhausted, change follows—this is why the Way of Heaven does not conceal itself, and why prognostications of a dynasty's duration prove enduring."
idiomatic: Attendant-in-Ordinary Pei, Regular Attendant Cao, Supervisor and Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army Duke of Jiancheng Liang, Left Guards General Jingren, Attendant-of-the-Interior and General Who Punishes Brigands Marquis of Longxiang Long, Colonel of Rapid Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Gang, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Suizhi, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi, Colonel of the Feathered Forest and Opening Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Senior Concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section, and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Gentleman of the Ministry of Rites Xu Changlin, Gentleman of the Ministry of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Gentleman of the Ministry of Punishments Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial: "We have heard that fortune and misfortune alternate; when the cycle reaches its limit, change ensues. That is why Heaven's way does not hide itself, and why auguries of a dynasty's span endure."

literal: Recently the mandate has declined, the royal house has been in distress, and commands from the nine domains have had nowhere to go; the enterprise of the High Ancestor was about to fall to the ground.
idiomatic: Of late the mandate has waned, the royal house has fallen on hard times, and the allegiance of the realm has had nowhere to turn; the founding enterprise was on the verge of collapse.

literal: Relying on your deep and thick foundation of virtue, men and spirits alike lent their aid, so that the altars of state were secured and the living were brought to order.
idiomatic: Thanks to your profound virtue, heaven and earth lent their support, the altars of state were secured, and the people were restored to peace.

literal: We humbly consider that Your Majesty's sovereign virtue is innate, sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty shine in the family and state, and your civilizing influence is proclaimed in the border provinces.
idiomatic: We humbly observe that Your Majesty's royal virtue is innate, sagely wisdom guides the throne, filial piety and fraternity are manifest at home and abroad, and your civilizing influence extends through the frontier commanderies.

literal: Therefore auspicious signs have come in profusion, and talismanic omens blaze with brilliance.
idiomatic: Hence auspicious portents have crowded in, and prophetic signs have blazed forth.

literal: The spirits of the ancestral temple have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and the common people look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you.
idiomatic: The spirits of the ancestral temple have turned westward in favor; all the realms and peoples look to your radiance and place their hopes in you.

literal: We, who undeservedly bear office in the court, have had the honor of carrying your commission, and again gather in this flourishing and enlightened age, once more beholding the enterprise of great peace.
idiomatic: We who unworthily serve in court ranks have been privileged to bear your commission, and now find ourselves again in a flourishing age, witnessing once more the advent of great peace.

literal: When the itinerant headquarters arrived and halted, gazing upon the city towers, we could not contain our joy like ducks on the waterweed; we respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial for your information.
idiomatic: When the mobile secretariat arrived and we beheld the capital towers, we could scarcely contain our joy; we respectfully present this memorial at the gate to inform Your Majesty.

literal: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed, and the number has struck repeated adversity; looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and recall the state's past, forever longing for that person, and grief and emotion mingle together.
idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been beset with hardship, and the times have brought repeated adversity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I recall the nation's past and forever mourn that person; grief and emotion overwhelm me.

literal: Relying on the enduring fortune of the seven hundred years, and on loyal and worthy arms and legs of state, we have therefore been able to turn adversity into prosperity and bring heaven and man into proper order.
idiomatic: Thanks to the enduring mandate of seven hundred years and to loyal, worthy ministers, adversity has been turned to prosperity and heaven and humanity brought into harmony.

literal: I am unworthy in my baseness, yet the great mandate has mistakenly descended upon me; looking back at myself I tremble with fear—how could I bear it?
idiomatic: Unworthy as I am, the great mandate has mistakenly fallen to me; I tremble at myself—how could I be equal to it?

literal: I shall for the present return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men set forth what is in my heart.
idiomatic: I shall presently return to court, pay mourning respects at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy ministers express what is in my heart.

literal: I hope you will enter into my feelings and not be excessive in your words.
idiomatic: I ask you to understand my heart and not be excessive in your expressions.

literal: The aides and clerks of the prefecture and province all styled themselves subjects and requested that placards be inscribed on every gate, all according to the palace standards; the Emperor did not permit it.
idiomatic: The aides and clerks of the prefecture and province all styled themselves subjects and asked that placards be posted on every gate in palace fashion; the Emperor did not consent.

literal: On the jiaxu day, he set out from Jiangling.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, he departed from Jiangling.

literal: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.
idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.

literal: [1] On the dingyou day, he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and assumed the imperial throne.
idiomatic: [1] On the dingyou day, he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and ascended the throne.

literal: On the dingyou day of the eighth month in autumn of the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and the second year of Jingping was changed to the first year of Yuanjia.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the eighth month in autumn of the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the second year of Jingping was renamed the first year of Yuanjia.

literal: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of promotion; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.
idiomatic: Civil and military officials were promoted two ranks; overdue rents and old debts were remitted.

literal: On the gengzi day, Xie Hui, Acting General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Xie Hui, Acting General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was confirmed as General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province.

literal: On the guimao day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister of Works, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to Minister over the Masses; Wang Hong, General of the Guard and Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was given the additional title of Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and Palace Minister of Equal Rank with the Three Dukes; Xie Hui, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced in title to General of the Guard; Tan Daoji, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns against the North.
idiomatic: On the guimao day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister of Works, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to Minister over the Masses; Wang Hong, General of the Guard and Governor of Jiang Province, became Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was additionally appointed Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Xie Hui, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to General of the Guard; Tan Daoji, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to General Who Campaigns against the North.

literal: On the jiachen day, his biological mother, Lady Hu, Gentleman of Graceful Beauty, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager, with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day, his birth mother, Lady Hu, Gentleman of Graceful Beauty, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the temple name Empress Zhang.

literal: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was advanced in title to General of Agile Cavalry; Yigong, General Who Conquers and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the Army and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.
idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry; Yigong, General Who Conquers and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

literal: The sixth younger imperial brother, Yixuan, was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother, Yiji, as Prince of Hengyang.
idiomatic: The sixth imperial younger brother Yixuan was created Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger brother Yiji was created Prince of Hengyang.

literal: On the wushen day, Liu Cui, Governor of Yu Province, was made Governor of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Governor of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was made General of the Central Army.
idiomatic: On the wushen day, Liu Cui, Governor of Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, became Governor of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was appointed General of the Central Army.

literal: On the jiyou day, this year's cloth tax of Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the cloth tax for Jing and Xiang provinces for the current year was reduced by half.

literal: On the bingzi day of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as Empress.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the ninth month, Lady Yuan was installed as Empress.

literal: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the second year, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing, submitted memorials returning power to the throne, and the Emperor began to attend to affairs in person.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the second year, Minister over the Masses Xu Xianzhi and Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang submitted memorials restoring government to the throne, and the Emperor began to rule in person.

literal: On the xinwei day, the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the southern suburb; [2] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb; [2] a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the yichou day of the third month, Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the North.
idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month, Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North.

literal: On the wuyin day in the fifth month of summer, Xie Dan, Special Grandee, died.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day in the fifth month of summer, Special Grandee Xie Dan died.

literal: On the jiashen day in the eighth month of autumn, because refugees from the Guanzhong region had fled out through the Han River valley, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, Fengyi, and others were established.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day in the eighth month of autumn, because Guanzhong refugees had fled into the Han River region, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, Fengyi, and others were established.

literal: On the yiyou day, the Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Wang Hong, newly appointed Minister of Works, was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Jiang Heng, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was made Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, received the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong became Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the same privilege; and Jiang Heng, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

literal: On the guiyou day in the eleventh month of winter, Yang Xuan, former General of the Front, was made General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day in the eleventh month of winter, former General of the Front Yang Xuan was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province.

literal: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the third year, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Protects the Army, and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, were guilty and executed.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the third year, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Protects the Army, and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, were found guilty and executed.

literal: The Central Army General Dao Yanzhi and the General Who Campaigns against the North Tan Daoji were sent to attack Xie Hui, Governor of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the Six Armies on a western campaign.
idiomatic: General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and General Who Campaigns against the North Tan Daoji were dispatched against Xie Hui, Governor of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the Six Armies westward.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the dingmao day, Wang Hong, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, was made Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province; the Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was transferred to Governor of Jing Province; the Prince of Jiangxia, Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was transferred to Governor of Southern Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Wang Hong, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, became Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Southern Xu Province.

literal: On the jisi day, Zhao Lunzhi, former General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
idiomatic: On the jisi day, former General Who Protects the Army Zhao Lunzhi was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

literal: On the bingxu day of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.

literal: On the yimao day of the second month, all prisoners in custody and convicts under sentence were entirely pardoned.
idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month, all prisoners in custody and convicts under sentence were fully pardoned.

literal: On the wuwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section; Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section; Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section.

literal: Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was guilty and executed.
idiomatic: Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was found guilty and executed.

literal: [3] On the gengshen day, Fan Tai, Special Grandee, was given the additional title of Grandee of Splendid Virtue.
idiomatic: [3] On the gengshen day, Special Grandee Fan Tai was additionally appointed Grandee of Splendid Virtue.

literal: On that day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital.
idiomatic: That same day, the imperial carriage departed the capital.

literal: On the wuchen day, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji routed Xie Hui decisively at Yinji.

literal: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage turned back from Wuhu.

literal: On the jimao day, Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.
idiomatic: On the jimao day, Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.

literal: On the xinsi day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: On the yiwei day in the fifth month of summer, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province; Dao Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day in the fifth month of summer, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province; Dao Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, became Governor of Southern Yu Province.

literal: On the wuxu day, the Prince of Changsha, Yixin, General of the Rear, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Rear, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the yisi day, Juqu Mengxun, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liang Province, was changed to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
idiomatic: On the yisi day, Juqu Mengxun, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liang Province, was redesignated Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

literal: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends his four senses, yet still tours the mountains and inspects the regions, gathering folk songs to observe government.
idiomatic: An edict said: "When a sage king rules the world, he extends his awareness in every direction, yet still tours the sacred mountains and inspects the regions, gathering folk songs to observe how government is conducted.

literal: By this means truth and falsehood are surely examined, the remote and hidden are not blocked, the king's favor is not obstructed, and the nine marshes have those who will listen.
idiomatic: Thus truth and falsehood are thoroughly examined, the distant and obscure are not neglected, royal grace is not blocked, and news reaches the court from every quarter.

literal: I, in my paltriness and shallowness, have basely succeeded to the great succession.
idiomatic: I, paltry and shallow as I am, have unworthily inherited the great enterprise.

literal: Although I forever bear governance in mind and aspire to rise before dawn, longing for Fu Yue's cliff and rousing my thoughts even in sleep, yet the excellence of hill and garden remains hidden and its vessels unrevealed, and the feelings of things and the grievances of the people are still cut off from sight and hearing.
idiomatic: Though I constantly ponder the way of governance and aspire to rise before dawn, longing for a Fu Yue in my service and thinking of it even in sleep, worthy men in retirement remain unrevealed, and the people's circumstances and hidden grievances still do not reach my ears.

literal: Therefore I turn my thoughts to the realm, laying aside sleep and forgetting to eat.
idiomatic: Therefore my thoughts turn to the realm; I set aside sleep and forget my meals.

literal: Now the baleful vapors have been swept away and the realm within the four seas is tranquil; to raise the worthy and expand transformation begins from this moment.
idiomatic: Now the evil mists have been cleared and the realm is at peace; the promotion of worthies and the spread of civilizing influence begin here.

literal: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.
idiomatic: Grand envoys shall be dispatched to tour the four quarters.

literal: As for prefects and magistrates who are competent, and goodness even in a single man of humble gate, report them all in detail and let none be omitted.
idiomatic: As for prefects and magistrates who perform their duties well, and any good act by even the humblest subject, report all in full and omit nothing.

literal: If punishments and prisons are not compassionate, or government and policy are perverse, harming the people and injuring instruction, report the facts in full.
idiomatic: If judicial punishments lack mercy, or governance is perverse and harms the people and undermines instruction, report the particulars in full.

literal: As for the aged, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and those with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves, the commanderies and counties may generously assess relief and provide for them.
idiomatic: As for the elderly, widows and widowers, orphans and the young, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves, the commanderies and counties shall generously assess relief and provide for them.

literal: Broadly gather popular songs, widely receive excellent plans, and strive to fulfill the intent of your commission, as though I were viewing matters in person.
idiomatic: Gather popular songs broadly, receive excellent counsel widely, and fulfill the intent of your commission as though I were reviewing matters myself.

literal: On the bingwu day, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Extending Worth to hear lawsuits.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Emperor presided at the Hall for Extending Worth to hear lawsuits.

literal: On the jiwei day of the sixth month, Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and General of the Forward Army.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the sixth month, Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Pacifies the Army, was appointed Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and General of the Forward Army.

literal: On the bingyin day, the imperial carriage again heard lawsuits at the Hall for Extending Worth.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the Emperor again heard lawsuits at the Hall for Extending Worth.

literal: On the bingzi day, he again heard lawsuits.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day, he again heard lawsuits.

literal: Wang Hua of the Right Guards was made General of the Guard.
idiomatic: Wang Hua of the Right Guards was appointed General of the Guard.

literal: On the wuyin day in the eleventh month of winter, Ji Han, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was made Governor of Yi Province; Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of Agile Cavalry, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day in the eleventh month of winter, Ji Han, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yi Province; Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of Agile Cavalry, became Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

literal: On the jihai day, Liu Zunkao, Colonel of Southern Man, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the jihai day, Liu Zunkao, Colonel of Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Sihua, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing, was made Governor of Qing Province.
idiomatic: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Sihua, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

literal: On the renxu day, Xu Peizhi, former Administrator of Wu Commandery, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
idiomatic: On the renxu day, former Administrator of Wu Commandery Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.

literal: On the yihai day, the first of the first month in spring of the fourth year, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.
idiomatic: On the yihai day, the new year's day of the first month in spring of the fourth year, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.

literal: On the xinsi day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

literal: On the yimao day of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.

literal: On the bingzi day of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by native place and intimate ties; the great enterprise began there. Treading that ground, I forever cherish it, and my stirred feelings know no limit.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by native soil and deep ties; the great enterprise began there. Setting foot on that ground awakens everlasting feeling, and my stirred emotions know no bound.

literal: Formerly, when Emperor Zhang of Han toured the south, he added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more, when affection and righteousness are two or threefold, does this exceed former days.
idiomatic: When Emperor Zhang of Han toured the south, he extended favor to the Yuan clan; how much more should I, when affection and obligation are redoubled, exceed what was done in former days.

literal: I think to spread lingering grace and repay and comfort the gentry and people.
idiomatic: I wish to spread lingering grace and repay and comfort the gentry and people.

literal: Let this county's grain and cloth tax for this year be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released;
idiomatic: Let this county's grain and cloth tax for the current year be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are to be fully pardoned and released;

literal: families of those who fought in the three assaults on the city wall and families of great generals shall receive condolence and relief as appropriate.
idiomatic: families of those who fought in the three assaults on the walls and families of great generals shall receive condolence and relief as appropriate.

literal: On the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: On the wuzi day, Zheng Xianzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section, died.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Zheng Xianzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section, died.

literal: On the renyin day, the use of five-colored life-cords and the like on the summer solstice was forbidden—this was the proposal of Zhuge Chanzhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.
idiomatic: On the renyin day, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored life cords and similar items was forbidden—this followed the proposal of Zhuge Chanzhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.

literal: On the gengxu day in the fourth month of summer, Wang Huizhi, Commandant of Punishments, was made Governor of Jiao Province.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day in the fourth month of summer, Wang Huizhi, Commandant of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

literal: On the renwu day in the fifth month, Wang Hua, General of the Guard, died.
idiomatic: On the renwu day in the fifth month, Wang Hua, General of the Guard, died.

literal: An epidemic struck the capital; on the jiawu day, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;
idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; on the jiawu day, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;

literal: if the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were bestowed upon them.
idiomatic: where the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were provided.

literal: On the guimao day, the first of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
idiomatic: On the guimao day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On the gengshen day, Yin Mu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Yin Mu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

literal: On the yihai day of the first month in spring of the fifth year, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over feasting on the four seas; civilization is not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities; seeking it in human affairs, I reflect whether awake or asleep with only worry.
idiomatic: On the yihai day of the first month in spring of the fifth year, an edict said: "I respectfully inherit the great enterprise and rule over the four seas; civilization is not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance remains obscure in many respects; when I seek guidance in human affairs, I reflect whether waking or sleeping with nothing but anxiety.

literal: Moreover, of late yin and yang have been out of order, drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to the warning of disaster, the blame lies deep with me.
idiomatic: Moreover, of late yin and yang have fallen out of harmony, and drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to these warnings of disaster, the blame lies chiefly with me.

literal: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, answer heaven's reproof above, and comfort the people's afflictions below.
idiomatic: I consider how to examine myself and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, answer heaven's reproof above, and relieve the people's afflictions below.

literal: The host of ministers and the hundred offices: each shall present loyal words, point out gains and losses, and let nothing be concealed.
idiomatic: Ministers and officials of every rank: each shall present loyal counsel, point out what is right and wrong, and conceal nothing.

literal: On the jiashen day, the imperial carriage attended at the Black Tortoise Pavilion to review the troops.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Emperor attended at the Black Tortoise Pavilion to review the troops.

literal: On the wuzi day, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort the people and grant relief.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour the districts, comfort the people, and grant relief.

literal: On the jihai day in the fourth month of summer, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: On the jihai day in the fourth month of summer, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: On the wuwu day, Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was made Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
